evidence_summary: Iodine is required for thyroid hormone synthesis.
Both inadequate and excessive iodine intake can be relevant to thyroid health.
Pregnancy raises iodine requirements, but thyroid disease and medication context can change safety decisions.
personalization: Use only validated indication- and formulation-specific evidence; goals and symptoms alone do not establish deficiency or benefit.
review_tasks: Validate source references and population-specific outcomes
Resolve canonical question IDs and conditional safety gates
Do not infer supplement dose from RDA, AI, UL or unrelated trial protocol
